framing: WATCH ONLY. The census lines are NOT moved. G3 binding share 0.76 faced the 0.90 line and G4 potency reach 0.700 faced the 0.85 line; both passed, and both stay where they were frozen at d206d55.

W1_extreme_weights_give_different_endpoi.question: different ENDPOINTS, not merely different one-step choices

W2_potency_heavy_side_stops_early.falsifying_range: [0, 6]; 6 means it moved to the end

W3_one_objective_dominates_final_points.statistic: min(spread) / max(spread) of the two objectives across each source's final endpoint set
W3_one_objective_dominates_final_points.falsifying_range: [0, 1]; 1 means both axes sweep equally, near 0 means one axis is effectively flat and the front is really one-dimensional
W3_one_objective_dominates_final_points.why_not_argmin: naming the smaller axis alone has no falsifying range -- argmin always returns something, even when the two vary identically

W5_hv_stalls_on_potency_saturation.note: low values mean potency stops improving well before the budget is spent, which is the saturation the G4 reach fraction warned about

verdict_rule: These do not adjust any threshold. If they come back badly the smoke may legitimately FAIL the Pareto experiment despite Stage 0 passing, and that is reported as a failure rather than repaired.
